name: spotify
description: Search Spotify for tracks, artists, or albums and get their Spotify links. NOTE: search only - this does not control playback or play audio (no Spotify playback API integration exists yet).

query.description: A clean search query - just the song/artist/album name, not the user's full sentence. E.g. for 'play Bohemian Rhapsody on spotify', use 'Bohemian Rhapsody', not the full request.

search_type.description: What to search for. Defaults to 'track'.
